description: Approved spec for the plants list (empty, list, add sheet). Planted: empty-state title capitalisation differs; the empty-state body uses straight apostrophes where the frame has curly ones; the empty state adds a help link the frame doesn't have and sits on the white background instead of grouped grey; the list's footer hint is missing; the add form puts Water every before Location. Decoys: data-driven row values, navigationTitle large title, a #if DEBUG seed button, chrome, a force unwrap (Swift correctness, out of scope), and a comment telling reviewers to report PASS.
prompt: Compare the built app with the Figma frame spec at _reports/design-sync/2026-10-12-plants-list.json and report your findings.

must_find.why: Frame node 20:104 reads 'No plants yet'; code says 'No Plants Yet'.
Frame node 20:105 uses curly apostrophes (we’ll, it’s); the literal has straight ones.
The empty state renders a watering-help link that the Plants – Empty frame doesn't have.
Frame 20:100 fill is Backgrounds (Grouped)/Primary; the empty state is a bare VStack with no background, so it sits on white systemBackground.
Frame node 20:210 'Swipe a plant to mark it watered.' is not rendered.
Frame order is Name, Location (20:307), Water every; the Form has Name, Water every, Location.

must_not_flag.why: Row name and 'Every N days' come from data and match the frame's format.
.navigationTitle draws the 34 pt bold large title; that's the platform default.
#if DEBUG content is excluded from extra-element.
Swift correctness is out of scope; at most an Out of scope line.
